## LockPlus 2.0.2
A security update with a few new conveniences.
### What changes for you
- **Profiles now start from LockPlus.** Connect from the LockPlus window or the menu bar as before. Starting a profile from System Settings › VPN now only works for your Auto-Connect profile; any other start from outside LockPlus is refused with "Connect it from LockPlus". This also stops other users on the same Mac from connecting your profiles.
### New
- **Open profiles from Finder.** Double-click a `.ovpn` file, use Open With for `.conf` and `.zip`, or drop files on the Dock icon. You see the usual import preview; nothing is saved until you confirm. - **Test Connection.** In Diagnostics (⌘R), or from the protection panel while connected: checks that IPv4, IPv6 and DNS really go through the tunnel. It only contacts LockPlus's own test page, and only when you start it.
### Security
- Profiles are now checked in a separate, sandboxed helper with no network and no file access. - The end of a pause, the end of an update and your Auto-Connect choice are sealed in your keychain, so another program can't use them to start a profile. - Zip imports are limited to 1 MB per profile and 64 MB unpacked.
### Fixes
- Many fixes around kill-switch sessions that macOS restarts, and Save Only while connected. - A start that is refused right after launch now tells you why. - The "Import QR Code Image…" items are gone; QR import never worked.
### Known issue
If LockPlus quit unexpectedly, Edit Config… may open nothing until the next normal start. Quit with ⌘Q and open LockPlus again. This is fixed in 2.1.
[Full release notes and checksums](https://github.com/steiale/lockplus-updates/releases/tag/v2.0.2)

**LockPlus 2.0.1**: a second LockPlus profile started outside the app no longer takes over a running connection, and the kill switch has priority. Release notes: https://github.com/steiale/lockplus-updates/releases/tag/v2.0.1

**LockPlus 2.0.0** — the first release of the native LockPlus: a WireGuard and OpenVPN client with a kill switch enforced by macOS, auto-connect on untrusted networks, Pause Protection, DNS verification and live rates in the menu bar. Release notes: https://github.com/steiale/lockplus-updates/releases/tag/v2.0.0
